Results.ReviewText: The grill is great - quick to heat, nice looks, well built, and easy to operate.  The assembly can be trying and really not a job for one person.  The tank holder/gauge needs a redesign in that it doesn't hold the a gas tank with a formed handhold in the back.  The gauge lip to hold the tank is to narrow so you have to mount the tank sidways.  The gas line is too short to allow you to mount it in any way other than with the valve pointed to the rear if you're using a dial type in line gas gauge.  The wheel caps keep coming off when the grill is moved from place to place because the axle shifts from side to side, forcing them off the wheel.  Other than these minor issues, this is a great grill and one I recommend for a small family or a tight space.
Results.Title: Great - But A Few Improvements Needed

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
